title: Concept: Dependency declared with a caret on a zero-zero version
description: package.json declares a caret range on a `0.0.x` version, which npm treats as an exact patch lock, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration looks like a range but admits only one patch, so a security fix in the next patch never installs while the manifest appears permissive.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The declaration looks like a range but admits only one patch, so a security fix in the next patch never installs while the manifest appears permissive.
